title: Execution limits preview

availability.server: Requires enabled Governance service and a current paired desktop session with accepted workspace membership.

qualification: Current local implementation; no full MVP, runtime coverage, baseline enrollment or provider-action authorization claim.

roles.review: Current agent:approve capability (owner/admin/security_reviewer mapping), independent of requester and named executors.
roles.manage: Current policy:manage capability for activation and revocation. UI role presentation does not grant server authority.

recovery.stored: Inert original operation/nonce and safe ID/digest/expected version where applicable; never policy payload, credentials or authority.
recovery.unknown: Absent, unavailable or session-refused history retains the blocker. Do not create a replacement nonce to retry.
recovery.historicalObservation: Original actor/session-bound lookup; exactProposalContentVerified:false. A verified result clears only its exact local locator; reload current policy separately.
recovery.containment: An unrelated valid unresolved locator blocks grants but permits a fresh authorized exact revoke. An unresolved revoke for that same policy blocks a replacement revoke. Corrupt, overflowing or unavailable storage blocks mutations.
recovery.bounds: At most 20 pending namespace records and 10000 storage keys scanned; failures do not evict history.

controls.label: Load saved limit policies
controls.purpose: Read up to 20 recent policies; a bounded list is not complete history.

controls.label: Load my recorded decisions
controls.purpose: Read up to 20 recorded decisions for the original paired session; missing history does not establish failure.

controls.label: Load exact policy
controls.purpose: Read the exact saved ID and verify its organization and offered scope.

controls.label: Read current limit pointer
controls.purpose: Read the current pointer for the loaded approved policy scope before activation.

controls.label: Check original saved outcome
controls.purpose: Look up the unchanged in-memory original request and exact expected result; never resend.

controls.label: Observe original request history
controls.purpose: Observe a persisted original locator as historical metadata only; no proposal content or current authority is restored.

controls.label: Saved limit policies
controls.purpose: Select an ID locally; load the exact policy separately.

controls.label: Saved execution-limit policy ID
controls.purpose: Enter an exact saved policy ID; editing clears the loaded policy, pointer and review.

controls.label: Select policy from this receipt
controls.purpose: Select a historical receipt ID locally; this does not load or authorize the policy.

controls.label: Exact policy identifiers
controls.purpose: Disclose the exact ID, digest and parent digest.

controls.label: My recorded decisions in this paired session
controls.purpose: Disclose historical decisions without resending any request.

controls.label: Original request locator
controls.purpose: Disclose the original request nonce for historical lookup.

controls.label: I reviewed this exact scope, limit, named executors and expiry.
controls.purpose: Confirm local review of the loaded record; the checkbox is not server authority.

controls.label: Record independent limit approval
controls.purpose: Record independent review of an unexpired proposed policy. The reviewer must be neither requester nor named executor.

controls.label: Activate these limits
controls.purpose: Set the current numeric ceiling for the exact scope after approval, expiry and parent/pointer compare-and-swap checks. Does not activate Governance enrollment or execute an action.

controls.label: Revoke this limit policy
controls.purpose: Revoke the exact loaded nonrevoked revision with current management authority and expected version. Expiry does not prevent containment revocation.

controls.label: Exact policy scope
controls.purpose: Choose one baseline-provided repository/resource/environment tuple; scope edits clear the read parent and review.

controls.label: Named executors
controls.purpose: Choose current accepted owner, admin or operator members; actual action rights remain server checked.

controls.label: Maximum numeric level
controls.purpose: Choose integer 0–5. Level 0 permits eligible observations; level 1 adds recommendations; mutations require at least 4 plus all action checks. No broader meaning is promised for other levels.

controls.label: Eligible actions
controls.purpose: Choose exact action identifiers; an offered identifier does not establish coverage, connection or provider permission.

controls.label: Limit expiry
controls.purpose: Enter future local date/time; review its displayed absolute UTC value. No renewal or grace period is inferred.

controls.label: I reviewed this exact proposal and its named executors.
controls.purpose: Confirm the current draft locally; edits clear this confirmation.

controls.label: Load current workspace members
controls.purpose: Explicitly read members; only accepted eligible executor roles are offered.

controls.label: Read exact current limit parent
controls.purpose: Explicitly read the exact selected scope parent; required before saving.

controls.label: Save limits for independent review
controls.purpose: Persist a proposed ceiling after durable local locator reservation. Does not approve, activate or execute it.

controls.label: Check original proposal outcome
controls.purpose: Read the exact unchanged original proposal outcome; an unknown result remains blocked from resend.

controls.label: Load saved baselines
controls.purpose: Read recent saved baseline revisions; no baseline is authored.

controls.label: Load baseline review
controls.purpose: Read the exact saved baseline ID in this organization; changing or reloading it removes prior limits controls until validated.

controls.label: Select a saved baseline
controls.purpose: Select a saved baseline ID locally.

controls.label: Saved baseline revision ID
controls.purpose: Enter the exact baseline ID; no source collection or baseline enrollment occurs.

controls.label: Review typed rules and source bindings
controls.purpose: Disclose saved typed rules and source bindings, not current execution authority.

controls.label: Review execution limits preview
controls.purpose: Open the development-only execution limits lane; opening it does not fetch server data.

controls.label: Back to Settings
controls.purpose: Return to Settings without sending a policy decision.
